name: 47711-shortdecode-qwen3-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine. No context parallelism, no speculative decoding, no KV connector, no offload tier, no router.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, bf16, 8.2B parameters, ~16.4 GB of weights, vocabulary 151936, trained window 32768. Shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 10240 requests bounded, safety_seconds 1800.
workload: SHORT PROMPT, LONG DECODE, single turn. guidellm `synthetic_text`, 32 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens pinned exactly, `request_format: plain`, greedy (`temperature: 0.0`) with `ignore_eos: true`, driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A creative writing assistant expanding brief prompts into long passages for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# 47711-shortdecode-qwen3-8b-1gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.

# A BASE checkpoint: this workload is raw text completion, so no chat template is applied.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base
tensor-parallel-size: 1
# A request in this workload is 32 prompt + 256 output = 288 tokens.
max-model-len: 512
# Must match the client's 512 streams, or they queue instead of being resident together.
max-num-seqs: 512
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# NO environment variables belong to this item.
